id./param/scenario/cs/b_120_cs_100.pack|cs_: "Good morning, {var:1}. The sun is already up.
"This morning the High Priest came to the inn, told me to guide you to the summit, and left.
"The others who woke early have already headed to the summit.
"Let's go too. Take the mountain path from the entrance next to the cathedral to reach the summit."
